evidence.reason: At the current tip the direct-execution guard `if __name__ == "__main__": unittest.main()` sits at lines 2177-2178, but `class PartialHarnessCheckTests(unittest.TestCase)` is defined later at line 2181. `unittest.main()` defaults to exiting after the test run, so running this file as a script collects and runs only the classes defined above the guard and silently omits `PartialHarnessCheckTests` (the partial-release/recovery evidence tests) while still reporting success. This is an implementation defect in the intended direct-run behavior, not a request to enlarge scope; the fix is to relocate the guard to the end of the file.
